name: Babylonia

categories.label: Ziggurat points
categories.help: Points taken whenever you placed a token beside a ziggurat: one for each ziggurat you touch at that moment.

categories.label: Crop fields
categories.help: Points from crop field tiles your farmers claimed, including the city-count fields.

categories.label: Noble points at cities
categories.help: Points from your matching nobles whenever a city was surrounded (2 for each noble that matches and touches or connects to the city).

categories.label: City tile points
categories.help: Points everyone took each time a city tile was won: your city count at that moment.

categories.label: Ziggurat card city bonus
categories.help: Extra points from the Ziggurat card that pays 1 point for every two cities you hold when cities are scored.

categories.label: Ziggurat card: 10 points
categories.help: Tick if you took the one-time Ziggurat card that gives 10 points immediately.

categories.label: Cities in front of you
categories.help: City tiles you hold at the end; the most wins a tie.

notes: Base game, standard Ziggurat Card set; the 7-of-9 variant and no other variant is covered. Points are scored on the board track during play, so the sheet asks for running points by source; enter the totals from each source. Read the publisher (Ludonova) PDF. Player count taken from the rulebook setup, which gives board layouts for 2, 3 and 4 players.
